# Sheet reference

<!-- GENERATED by `pnpm api:generate` from `packages/core/src/sheet-schema.ts` — do not edit. -->

What a drawing sheet stores (P6-24, ADR-0143), field by field, as `d.toJSON()` writes it:
the sheet, its views and each kind of item. The calls that make them are in
[the README](./README.md#sheets). Positions on the sheet are mm from its top-left
corner, Y down; an item tied to a view is placed in the view's own mm (model size,
x right, y up). Nothing derived is stored: no line of a view, no measured value, no
parts list row; they are worked out each time the sheet is drawn. An anchor's `ref`
always carries its fingerprint.

## Sheet

Made by `d.addSheet(name, options)`, `sheet.update(setup)`.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | A UUID, for life. |
| `name` | string | yes | Unique among the sheets, compared case-insensitively. |
| `size` | "A4" \| "A3" \| "A2" \| "A1" \| "A0" \| "letter" \| "legal" \| "tabloid" \| [number, number] | yes | A named paper, or two sides in mm; the orientation decides which side is wide. |
| `orientation` | "landscape" \| "portrait" | yes | Landscape: the long side is horizontal. |
| `scale` | [number, number] | yes | The views' scale unless a view has its own. |
| `projection` | "first" \| "third" | yes | The projection angle projected views follow. |
| `decimals` | integer | yes | Decimals dimensions show, 0 to 4. |
| `border` | { zones: true } |  | Absent: no border. |
| `titleBlock` | { template, fields } |  | Absent: no title block. |

## View

Made by `sheet.addView(name, options)`, `view.project(side, at)`, `view.update(setup)`.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | A UUID, for life; unique in the design. |
| `name` | string | yes | "Front"; unique in its sheet, compared case-insensitively. |
| `at` | [number, number] | yes | The view's origin on the sheet, mm from the top-left corner, Y down. |
| `from` | { kind: "base", direction, up } \| { kind: "projected", parent, side } | yes | A direction chosen freely. Or: Projected from another view of the sheet. |
| `scale` | [number, number] |  | Absent: the sheet's. Never on a projected view. |
| `style` | "visible" \| "hidden" \| "shaded" \| "shaded-edges" |  | visible: visible edges only; hidden: and hidden edges dashed (the default). Never on a projected view. |
| `bodies` | string[] |  | The bodies drawn; absent: every shown body. One the design no longer has is skipped. |
| `tangentEdges` | false |  | Tangent edges left out (only as false). |
| `centreLines` | false |  | Centre lines left out (only as false). |
| `label` | true |  | The view's name and scale drawn under it (only as true). |

## Text

Made by `sheet.addText(text, at, options)`.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | "text" | yes | A text. |
| `id` | string | yes | A UUID, for life; unique in the design. |
| `at` | [number, number] | yes | The text's top-left corner, mm from the sheet's top-left, Y down. |
| `text` | string | yes | Plain text, up to 2000 characters; may contain newlines. |
| `size` | number |  | The letter height, mm; absent: 3.5. |
| `width` | number |  | Wraps at this width, mm; absent: no wrapping. |

## Dimension

Made by `view.addDimension(type, anchors, at, options)`.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | "dimension" | yes | A dimension. |
| `id` | string | yes | A UUID, for life; unique in the design. |
| `view` | string | yes | The view it measures in, on the same sheet. |
| `type` | "linear" \| "radius" \| "diameter" \| "angle" | yes | linear: a distance; radius, diameter: a circle; angle: between two lines. |
| `direction` | "horizontal" \| "vertical" \| "aligned" |  | A linear one: horizontal, vertical or aligned; absent: from where it is placed. |
| `anchors` | ({ ref, at? } \| { ref, silhouette } \| { free })[] | yes | What it measures: one or two anchors, as its type takes. |
| `at` | [number, number] | yes | Where its text is, in the view's own mm (model size, x right, y up); it follows the anchors when they move. |
| `decimals` | integer |  | Decimals shown, 0 to 4; absent: the sheet's. |
| `before` | string |  | Text before the value (and before R or Ø), up to 100 characters. |
| `after` | string |  | Text after the value, up to 100 characters. |
| `reference` | true |  | A reference dimension: drawn in brackets (only as true). |

## Leader note

Made by `view.addLeader(anchor, at, text)`.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | "leader" | yes | A leader note. |
| `id` | string | yes | A UUID, for life; unique in the design. |
| `view` | string | yes | The view whose geometry it points at, on the same sheet. |
| `anchor` | { ref, at? } \| { ref, silhouette } \| { free } | yes | What the arrow points at: a vertex, an edge or one of its points, a face (a dot), an outline, or a free point. |
| `at` | [number, number] | yes | Where the leader line ends and its text starts, in the view's own mm (model size, x right, y up); it follows the anchor when it moves. |
| `text` | string | yes | Plain text, up to 2000 characters; may contain newlines. |

## Sticky note

Made by `sheet.addSticky(text, at, options)`.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | "sticky" | yes | A sticky note. |
| `id` | string | yes | A UUID, for life; unique in the design. |
| `at` | [number, number] | yes | The note's top-left corner, mm from the sheet's top-left, Y down. |
| `size` | [number, number] | yes | The note's width and height, mm, 5 to 1000 each. |
| `text` | string | yes | Plain text, up to 2000 characters; may contain newlines. Wraps inside the note. |
| `color` | "yellow" \| "orange" \| "pink" \| "blue" \| "green" |  | yellow, orange, pink, blue or green; absent: yellow. |
| `print` | true |  | Printed and exported (only as true); absent: on screen only. |

## Centre mark

Made by `view.addCentreMark(anchor)`.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | "centreMark" | yes | A centre mark. |
| `id` | string | yes | A UUID, for life; unique in the design. |
| `view` | string | yes | The view it is drawn in, on the same sheet. |
| `anchors` | ({ ref, at? } \| { ref, silhouette } \| { free })[] | yes | The circle: one whole circular edge or a cylinder's face. |

## Centre line

Made by `view.addCentreLine(anchors)`.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | "centreLine" | yes | A centre line. |
| `id` | string | yes | A UUID, for life; unique in the design. |
| `view` | string | yes | The view it is drawn in, on the same sheet. |
| `anchors` | ({ ref, at? } \| { ref, silhouette } \| { free })[] | yes | Two parallel lines (whole edges or outlines: it runs midway), or a cylinder's or cone's face (along its axis). |

## Parts list

Made by `view.addPartsList(at, options)`.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | "partsList" | yes | A parts list. |
| `id` | string | yes | A UUID, for life; unique in the design. |
| `view` | string | yes | The view whose bodies it lists, on the same sheet. |
| `at` | [number, number] | yes | The table's top-left corner, mm from the sheet's top-left, Y down. |
| `columns` | ("item" \| "qty" \| "name" \| "material" \| "size" \| "mass")[] |  | The columns shown, in this order, each once: item, qty, name, material, size, mass; absent: all six. |
| `rows` | Record<string, { name?, material? }> |  | What was typed over a row, by the ID of the row's first body; a body the list no longer shows is ignored. |

## Balloon

Made by `view.addBalloon(anchor, at, list)`.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | "balloon" | yes | A balloon. |
| `id` | string | yes | A UUID, for life; unique in the design. |
| `view` | string | yes | The view whose geometry it points at, on the same sheet. |
| `anchor` | { ref, at? } \| { ref, silhouette } \| { free } | yes | What the leader points at, on the body it numbers: a vertex, an edge or one of its points, a face (a dot), or an outline. |
| `at` | [number, number] | yes | The circle's centre, in the view's own mm (model size, x right, y up); it follows the anchor when it moves. |
| `list` | string | yes | The parts list it takes its number from, on the same sheet. |

## Table

Made by `sheet.addTable(at, rows, options)`.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | "table" | yes | A free table. |
| `id` | string | yes | A UUID, for life; unique in the design. |
| `at` | [number, number] | yes | The table's top-left corner, mm from the sheet's top-left, Y down. |
| `columns` | number[] | yes | Each column's width, mm, 1 to 1000; 1 to 50 columns. |
| `rows` | string[][] | yes | The rows, top to bottom, each one cell text per column (plain, may be empty, may contain newlines); a row's height fits its text. |
